description: Shows the rules in force for this project's tool-call checks: the held rule set (version, mode, default, each rule on one line), the local rules and whether the checks file has them On or Calibrating, what happens to each protected tool if signafAIde can't be reached (Stop or Let it run), and the fields each protected tool discloses to the witness. Use it before explaining a ruling, or to see what a call would meet. Read-only: it reads local files, makes no request and changes nothing; `signafaide rules pull` fetches a newer version.

directory.description: Path of the project to work on: the folder the MCP server was started in, or one below it. Default: that folder.

name: signafaide_show_rules
title: Show the tool-call rules this project holds
